scientific.integrity: The branch contacts, resolution multiplicities, Tjurina saturation, and monodromy polynomial are stated with exact algebraic checks. The cited source supplies the explicit arrangement and identifies the point as the unique non-quasihomogeneous singularity.
scientific.limitations: Local result for the explicit Proposition 4.7 Type-II arrangement only; no classification of all Type-II pencils or claim that the abstract singularity topology is new.

title: Local resolution and monodromy of the Type-II conic-pencil singularity
